page_topic_one_liner: Link building — backlink acquisition channels, content-led natural links, outreach quality, and anchor-text best practices
differentiator_vs_generic: This is off-page SEO backlink strategy, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a backlink authority network graph showing inbound links to a central domain, NOT an AI outreach assistant or chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Backlink network diagram — central domain node (your-site.com blur) with 5–6 inbound curved arrows from external site nodes of varying sizes (authority signal), mars-green accent on strongest link
Secondary: one torn outreach email snippet card with blurred subject line and link-highlight underline
Tertiary: anchor-text distribution mini bar (brand / naked URL / generic blur segments)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is link building not GEO)
Generic chain-link icon alone without network graph
CRM pipeline or sales funnel UI unrelated to backlinks

en.headline: LINK BUILDING
en.subtitle: Quality Backlinks & Outreach
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for link building guide. HERO: backlink authority network graph occupying right two-thirds — central domain hub with inbound arrows from 5–6 external nodes, node size implying authority, mars-green accent on top link. Secondary: torn outreach email card with blurred text and one underlined link. Tertiary: small anchor-text mix bar chart. Title block top-left only. Paper collage torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat UI, NO OpenAI/Anthropic logos, NO real Ahrefs/Moz logos, NO PageRank numbers as text labels.
